data.summary: Stadtwerke Beispielsoest GmbH sent a dunning notice stating that the electricity and water advance payments (Abschläge) for October and November 2026, plus dunning fees, remain unpaid. They demand payment of the total €226.00 by 10 December 2026, otherwise they may interrupt the supply after prior notice.
data.explanation: This is a payment reminder (Mahnung) from your utility provider for unpaid advance payments (Abschläge) for electricity and water from October and November 2026, plus a €2 dunning fee. You should pay the total amount of €226.00 to the provider's IBAN by 10 December 2026. If you believe the amounts are wrong, contact the provider promptly to clarify before the deadline. If you do not pay, the letter warns that the energy/water supply could be interrupted after prior notice, which can have serious consequences, so treat this as urgent.
